key_insight: Apollo learns unified, temporally aware patient representations by pretraining a single foundation model on 25 billion longitudinal clinical records spanning 30+ years and 28 medical modalities, enabling virtual patient representations at healthcare-system scale.
problem_solved: Clinical data are fragmented across many modalities and time scales; there was no single model that integrates the full breadth and temporal depth of an individual’s electronic health record into one reusable patient representation.
method: Scale: Pretrain a multimodal foundation model on 25 billion records from 7.2M patients covering 28 distinct clinical modalities and decades of longitudinal data.
Unified representation: Encode heterogeneous inputs (structured EHR events, notes, images, labs, signals, etc.) into a common embedding space that preserves temporal structure.
Temporal modeling: Use sequence-aware aggregation to capture disease progression and longitudinal context for downstream clinical tasks and virtual patient simulation.
impact: Provides AI/ML practitioners a reusable, temporally rich patient embedding that supports transfer to many clinical tasks, accelerates development of virtual patient modeling, and enables evaluation at real-world healthcare system scale.
visual_elements: Timeline visual: multi-decade patient timeline showing dense events and modality icons to emphasize temporal depth
Modality wheel: circular diagram listing the 28 modalities (notes, labs, images, signals, prescriptions, procedures, etc.) feeding into a single encoder
Model pipeline schematic: encoder + temporal aggregator -> unified patient embedding -> multiple downstream tasks (risk prediction, cohort simulation, virtual patient)
Embedding map: UMAP/t-SNE scatter showing clusters of patient embeddings colored by diagnosis, specialty, or outcome
paper_title: A multimodal and temporal foundation model for virtual patient representations at healthcare system scale
paper_authors: Andrew Zhang, Tong Ding, Sophia J. Wagner, Caiwei Tian, Ming Y. Lu
